title: Magmatic Fireflies
description: Introduces a new Biome to the Nether to explore. As well as a new Entity, Wood Type, Tools among other stuff.
body:
Adds a new biome to the Nether to discover. 
In which multiple Structure, Fauna and Resources. As well as a new Entity.

![Picture of the new Biome. Yellow Fungi and other purple Plants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee6dbed83f955a25951b0cc2e860ea7af2348323_0.webp)

Harvest its Resources to craft new Tools, Weapons and Armor.

![Player wearing armor and holding a sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2574ba4294741a5636c050cd5c8c4f2394f5aa93_0.webp)

Or fish for new mysteroius Items.
![Fishing in Boiling Water with a special Fishing Rod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4933fffc96608fc02bba00aaad387be992284fe2.png)
